trigger: What did Apple report about the FY2023 decline?
reportedContext: Weaker foreign currencies against the U.S. dollar accounted for more than the full year-over-year decrease in total net sales.
Apple also reported lower Mac and iPhone net sales, partly offset by higher Services net sales.
takeaway: This was not a one-cause story.
interpretation: Currency effects and changes across Apple’s products and services are useful next things to investigate.
limitation: These annual Revenue totals alone cannot show exactly how much each factor contributed or what happened to Profit.

sources.title: Apple Inc. FY2023 Form 10-K
sources.location: Fiscal Year Highlights; Products and Services Performance
supports: reported Mac, iPhone and Services context
